notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build year, height or design. The marker is the only source that dates the tower, and it gives the in-use years 1955 to 1969 only. The Forest Lookouts page is nearly empty apart from the name, county and agency. A Waymarking NGS benchmark page (BL2173, title mentions 'LIBERTY HILL LOT 1966') came up in search, but the cached page held only its title, so it is not used. The hmdb marker has 2020 photos by James Hulse; not recorded because no license is stated. Access is unknown: no source says whether the tower may be climbed. NHLR and FFLOS register pages were not checked. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads.
